claim: DeepSeek's R1 system card (Jan 2025) reported evaluations for cyber and CBRN but did not include a published safety framework.

source.excerpt: DeepSeek R1 underwent cyber and CBRN capability evaluations. DeepSeek has not published a comprehensive safety framework.

claim: DeepSeek did NOT submit a Winter 2025 FLI Index survey response.

source.excerpt: DeepSeek did not submit a response to the FLI Winter 2025 industry survey.

provenance.context: FLI AI Safety Index Winter 2025 Appendix A. URL: https://futureoflife.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/AI-Safety-Index-Report_131225_Full_Report_Digital.pdf

claim: DeepSeek's V3 technical report (Dec 2024) included training-data disclosure but no detailed safety analysis.

source.excerpt: Our V3 technical report includes training-data composition details. Safety analysis focuses on benchmark evaluations rather than uplift studies.

provenance.context: DeepSeek V3 Technical Report (Dec 2024). URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.19437

claim: DeepSeek released R1 weights publicly under MIT license in January 2025, with no pre-deployment third-party red-teaming.

source.excerpt: DeepSeek R1 was released under MIT license. Pre-deployment third-party red-teaming was not conducted.

provenance.context: DeepSeek R1 weights release announcement (Jan 2025). URL: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
